static_fields.source:
无尽波次，每波开始自动保存。
持有 {sunGoal} 阳光即可领取胜利奖杯。

① 鼠标停在向日葵上产阳光，停在育种葵上生产植物，停在上方种子卡上加快冷却。金盏花用来生产植物卡牌，不掉金币，成品只进入底部「植物」栏。

② 读卡器拖到卡牌，花盆拖到草坪自动照料植物，咖啡暂时加速。道具、读卡器和花盆可拖回底栏或回收。

③ 每击败一波获得1研究点，底部「研究」升级七项能力，每项5级。研究和道具进度随开局、每波开始的记录点保存。

④ 上方分别探索向日葵和金盏花的新阶段，每阶段都有新道具或机制。商店「探索道具」购买一次性道具；拖到草坪使用。

⑤ 场上品质用植物右下角的彩色数字1～5表示，与花盆数字错开；向日葵和金盏花显示生产进度。右键植物查看详情。
static_fields.english:
Endless waves. Progress saves at the start of each wave.
Collect {sunGoal} Sun to claim the victory trophy.

1. Hover over Sunflowers to produce Sun, over Marigolds to produce plants, or over seed cards to reduce cooldowns. Marigolds produce plant cards instead of coins. Finished cards enter Plants in the bottom bar.

2. Drag Card Readers onto cards and Flower Pots onto the lawn to automate work. Coffee Beans temporarily boost speed. Items, Card Readers, and Flower Pots can be returned to the bar or recycled.

3. Defeat a wave to earn 1 Research Point. Use Research to upgrade seven abilities, each with five levels. Research and item progress save at the run-start and wave-start checkpoints.

4. Explore new stages for Sunflowers and Marigolds using their cards at the top. Each stage adds items or mechanics. Buy consumables in Explore Items, then drag them onto the lawn.

5. Colored numbers 1-5 beside plants show quality, separate from Flower Pot numbers. Sunflowers and Marigolds show production progress. Open a plant's details to inspect it.

Sprays fumes at groups of zombies and summons Squash helpers to crush nearby targets.

Damage: <color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>

Fusion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Fume-shroom + Squash</color>

plant_fields.english: Although often reported for settling disputes physically, 窝瓜大喷菇 insists it has never laid a hand on anyone. It explains that it only sprays a few harmless spores. As for the Squash frequently seen leaping from behind it to crush others, it says those are merely hallucinations caused by inhaling the spores.

Attracts nearby projectiles, adds its own damage, then sends them crashing down on zombies.

Usage Condition: <color=#8B0000>Odyssey Mode</color>
Fusion Recipe: <color=#8B0000>Squash-nut + Mag-nut</color>
Toughness: <color=#8B0000>4000</color>
Damage: <color=#8B0000>1800 (Crush)</color>

<color=#8B0000>1. Attracts horizontally fired projectiles within 1.5 tiles, increases their damage by [its own damage], and absorbs them. Projectile traits are not retained, and zombies are not attacked during this phase.
2. After absorbing 10 projectiles, distributes them evenly among zombies within range. Each projectile deals crush damage in a small area. During this attack, it does not block zombies.</color>
Odyssey Modifier 1: <color=#8B0000>窝爱砸: Targeting range becomes an entire lane.</color>
Odyssey Modifier 2: <color=#8B0000>窝爱吸: Attacks only after absorbing 30 projectiles.</color>
